name: Haritha Valley View Resort Restaurant
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine meals with a forest valley view
why_it_matters: The restaurant at Telangana Tourism's Haritha Valley View Resort — set in the dense forest of Ananthagiri Hills, the state's only hill station, near the Sri Anantha Padmanabha Swamy Temple. With a restaurant, coffee shop and bar, it is the genuine on-hill dining option for the weekend crowd escaping Hyderabad.
insider_tip: The valley-view setting is the reason to eat here rather than driving back down to Vikarabad town. It is a popular weekend spot, so reserving ahead helps. Combine a meal with the trekking trails and the temple.
signature_address: Telangana Tourism Haritha Valley View Resort, Ananthagiri Hills, Vikarabad, Vikarabad District, Telangana 501102

name: Taste of Vikarabad (TOV)
signature_dish: Bamboo chicken and local Telangana thali
why_it_matters: An open-air restaurant on the Ananthagiri Hills approach road — bamboo huts, open skies and forest sounds, serving authentic Telangana flavours. Its bamboo chicken (marinated and slow-cooked inside a bamboo stem) and local thali are the standout dishes, and the leafy setting makes it a favourite for the Vikarabad-Ananthagiri weekend crowd.
insider_tip: Order the bamboo chicken — it is the signature and worth the wait. The open-air bamboo-hut seating is best in the cooler months and evenings. Reserve on weekends; it fills with Hyderabad day-trippers.
signature_address: Ananthagiri Hills approach road, Vikarabad, Vikarabad District, Telangana 501101

name: Wah Biryani Wah! Family Restaurant
why_it_matters: A well-rated multi-cuisine family restaurant at NTR Chowrasta in Vikarabad town — with over 2,700 reviews, it is one of the most popular biryani addresses in the town that serves as the base for Ananthagiri Hills, about 11km away. Retro-themed and family-friendly, with biryani, kebabs and Chinese.
insider_tip: A Vikarabad town pick — convenient if you base in the town for the Ananthagiri trip. Biryani and kebabs are the strengths; the retro decor makes it good for families. Walk-in.
signature_address: KNR Complex, NTR Chowrasta, Vikarabad town, Vikarabad District, Telangana 501101

name: Ananthagiri Ruchulu Multicuisine Family Restaurant
area: Above Reliance Smart Point, Vikarabad town
signature_dish: Chicken biryani and multi-cuisine family meals
why_it_matters: A well-reviewed multi-cuisine family restaurant in Vikarabad town — over 1,000 reviews, rated highly across listings — covering Indian and Chinese. Named for the Ananthagiri hills it serves, it is a dependable Vikarabad-town meal for visitors to Telangana's hill station.
insider_tip: A reliable Vikarabad town option — biryani and pulao are the picks. Above the Reliance Smart point, easy to find on the main road. Walk-in.
signature_address: Above Reliance Smart Point, Vikarabad town, Vikarabad District, Telangana 501101

name: The Food Villa
area: Tandoor Road (route to Ananthagiri Hills), Vikarabad
why_it_matters: A small, homey multi-cuisine restaurant on Tandoor Road — the route from Vikarabad town towards Ananthagiri Hills. Well-maintained with a good ambience and a broad veg-and-non-veg menu, it is a practical meal stop on the drive up to the hills.
insider_tip: On the Tandoor Road route to the hills, so an easy stop on the way up or down. Pepper fish and paneer biryani are the dishes to order; vegetarian options are plentiful and it is family-friendly. Open 11.30am-10.30pm, walk-in.
signature_address: AL Wajid Colony, Tandoor Road, Vikarabad, Vikarabad District, Telangana 501101
